name: smtp-panel
description: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV + Queues 的 SMTP 批量发信管理系统

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run config && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.toml
scripts.dev:worker: npm run config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.generated.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.generated.toml
